note: Shared contract cases for how each client merges a session's server-declared group with the user's manual order (ADR 0017, which amends ADR 0006). Each case is a sidebar-order store plus a session list; the client resolves them with its own ordering model (web/public/session-order.js and the macOS app's Sources/AgentHub/Services/SidebarOrder.swift) and must produce the same groups, in the same order, with the same members. `serverGroups` is the store's record of group names adopted from session declarations rather than created by the user; a group James has claimed lives in `order` and is not server-declared. Membership is read from the sessions themselves, so these cases never consult the store's groups map for who belongs where — that map only orders a group's members.

cases.name: a session created in a group appears under that group, and a session with no declared group stays ungrouped
a new member is appended after the existing members, leaving their order alone
a session that declares another group moves out of the group it was stored under
a live session with no declared group is not held by a stored group
a server-declared group whose members are all gone is dropped without residue
